entries.en: The pont carried our truck across the river.
entries.zh: 缆拉渡船载着我们的卡车渡过了河。

entries.en: The annals preserve an account of the winter flood.
entries.zh: 编年史保存着那次冬季洪灾的记载。

entries.en: A portrait of the kaiser hung above the staircase.
entries.zh: 楼梯上方挂着一幅皇帝肖像。

entries.meaningZh: 衣着时髦的英国上流社会女子〔英式口语〕
entries.en: The satire portrays a Sloane shopping with her friends.
entries.zh: 这部讽刺作品描绘了一位衣着时髦的英国上流社会女子与朋友购物的情景。

entries.en: The woodward inspected the damaged trees before noon.
entries.zh: 森林管理员在中午前检查了受损的树木。

entries.en: She signed the receipt with a blue biro.
entries.zh: 她用一支蓝色圆珠笔在收据上签了名。

entries.en: The course develops foundational skills in logical reasoning.
entries.zh: 这门课程培养逻辑推理的基础技能。

entries.en: We played pedro until the lamps burned low.
entries.zh: 我们玩彼得牌戏，直到灯光渐暗。

entries.en: The astronomer adjusted the refractor before sunset.
entries.zh: 天文学家在日落前调整了折射望远镜。

entries.en: The beetle moved its antennae toward the leaf.
entries.zh: 甲虫将触角转向了叶片。

entries.en: The favorite looked a monty before the race.
entries.zh: 赛前，那匹热门马看起来必胜无疑。

entries.en: A Samson among the porters lifted the heavy crate.
entries.zh: 搬运工中的一位大力士抬起了沉重的木箱。

entries.en: She translated the announcement from Zulu into English.
entries.zh: 她把公告从祖鲁语译成英语。

entries.en: His oppositional attitude made cooperation difficult.
entries.zh: 他的对抗态度使合作变得困难。

entries.en: The glover stitched the soft leather by hand.
entries.zh: 做手套的工人用手缝制柔软的皮革。

entries.en: The mechanic cleaned the derailleur after the muddy ride.
entries.zh: 泥泞路段骑行结束后，机械师清洁了自行车变速器。

entries.en: The manuscript depicts a Saracen beside a horse.
entries.zh: 手稿描绘了一位站在马旁的撒拉森人。

entries.en: The seminar examined debates surrounding Thatcherism.
entries.zh: 研讨会探讨了围绕撒切尔主义的争论。

entries.en: The report calls for stronger intergovernmental cooperation.
entries.zh: 报告呼吁加强政府间合作。

entries.en: The gallery displayed paintings of Viennese streets.
entries.zh: 画廊展出了描绘维也纳街道的画作。

entries.en: Her youngest grandkid made her a birthday card.
entries.zh: 她年纪最小的孙辈孩子给她做了一张生日贺卡。

entries.en: The lecture reviewed research on foodborne infections.
entries.zh: 讲座回顾了食物传播感染的相关研究。

entries.en: The records describe an eyre held that summer.
entries.zh: 记录描述了那年夏天举行的一次巡回法庭审理。

entries.en: The prisoner resented being called a Fritz.
entries.zh: 俘虏不满自己被蔑称为德国佬。

entries.en: The monks crossed the garth in silence.
entries.zh: 僧侣们默默地穿过中庭。

entries.en: The program encourages intergenerational dialogue between mothers and daughters.
entries.zh: 这项计划鼓励母女之间的代际对话。

entries.en: The committee considered the rising costs unsustainable.
entries.zh: 委员会认为不断上升的成本已无法支撑。

entries.en: A protestor held a sign outside the building.
entries.zh: 一位抗议者在楼外举着标语牌。

entries.en: The guide kept a bowie in its leather sheath.
entries.zh: 向导把一把鲍伊猎刀放在皮鞘里。

entries.en: The students completed a practicum at a local school.
entries.zh: 学生们在当地一所学校完成了实习课。

entries.en: The novel describes a village damaged by an airstrike.
entries.zh: 小说描写了一个遭空袭破坏的村庄。

entries.en: The waller fitted another stone into the gap.
entries.zh: 石垛工将另一块石头嵌进了空隙。

entries.en: He replaced the frayed snell before casting.
entries.zh: 抛线前，他更换了磨损的系钩线。

entries.en: The exhibition explores Northumbrian history through local manuscripts.
entries.zh: 展览通过当地手稿探索诺森伯兰的历史。

entries.en: The new intercity service reduced our travel time.
entries.zh: 新的城际交通服务缩短了我们的旅行时间。

entries.en: She served chang in a small wooden bowl.
entries.zh: 她用一个小木碗端上了青稞酒。

entries.en: The mural depicts an Inca carrying a basket.
entries.zh: 壁画描绘了一位提着篮子的印加人。

entries.en: The workshop teaches canning through practical demonstrations.
entries.zh: 这个工作坊通过实际演示教授罐头制造。

entries.en: The student calculated the discriminant of the quadratic equation.
entries.zh: 学生计算了这个二次方程的判别式。

entries.en: They tested an epoxy coating on the metal.
entries.zh: 他们在金属上测试了一种环氧涂层。

entries.en: The publisher corrected several errors during typesetting.
entries.zh: 出版社在排字过程中纠正了几处错误。

entries.en: The keyboard sends note data through MIDI.
entries.zh: 键盘通过乐器数字化接口发送音符数据。

entries.en: The marsh is especially birdy in early spring.
entries.zh: 这片沼泽在早春时鸟类特别多。

entries.en: The shipwright inspected a cracked carling below deck.
entries.zh: 造船工检查了甲板下一根开裂的短纵梁。
